in_sanskrit.name: यशु
in_sanskrit.meaning: यश: विद्यते तत् पुरुष: पुरुषव्यस्य: प्रसन्नत्वम्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: He whose Yasha (glory, fame) exists in him and in others. A happy, contented man.

in_hindi.name: यशु
in_hindi.meaning: यश: वह जीवन का विधानी है
in_hindi.long_meaning: He who is the rule, the law of life, the one who possesses Yash (glory, fame)
